description: A real trivia quiz with a built-in bank of 50 questions — 10 random questions per round, four options each, instant scoring.

faqs.a: 50 real questions across science, history, geography, sports, arts and tech. Each round draws 10 at random.
Four options per question, one correct answer, scored instantly with the right answer shown.
Your best score out of 10 is saved in this browser.

howto: Answer 10 random questions from the 50-question bank.
See your score with correct answers revealed.
Try to beat your best score.
title: Trivia Quiz Game
